jobs.answer: Cannot access kernel 'davideferrante11/dt-ntc-inputs-01a11c34-r4' (Permission 'kernels.get' was denied). The most likely cause is a wrong kernel slug. The benchmark_task_slug returned by get_benchmark_leaderboard differs from the actual kernel slug — use the slug from the notebook URL (kaggle.com/code/owner/KERNEL-SLUG), not from the leaderboard. It can also occur if the notebook is private.
